load_consolidation_agent.division_context: Consolidates vendor and FC-to-Sort-Center shipments into high-density FTL routes to maximize Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) fleet utilization across India.

yard_dock_sequencer.division_context: Monitors incoming linehaul GPS data to dynamically reassign dock doors at Amazon Sort Centers, preventing gate congestion.

cold_chain_auditor.division_context: Analyzes IoT sensor data from Amazon Fresh reefer trucks to detect temperature breaches and automate carrier accountability.

aisle_aligned_pallet_agent.division_context: Directs Fulfillment Center (FC) pick waves so that outbound pallets for Amazon Fresh stores are organized by aisle, speeding up shelf replenishment.

store_capacity_agent.division_context: Prevents congestion at Amazon Fresh backrooms by adjusting replenishment flow based on real-time sales and physical storage limits.

port_drayage_orchestrator.division_context: Synchronizes Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) truck arrivals with city-specific 'No-Entry' timings and local delivery station labor shifts across India.

geocoding_intelligence_agent.division_context: Interprets complex Indian landmarks, gate codes, and neighborhood-specific delivery notes to provide precise 'last-meter' guidance for Amazon Logistics (AMZL) drivers.

multimodal_mode_shift_agent.division_context: Optimizes the allocation of parcels between Amazon's internal Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) fleet, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs), and external 3PLs based on real-time rate cards and regional capacity.

otif_penalty_shield.division_context: Monitors Amazon Logistics (AMZL) delivery progress in real-time, identifying potential misses and proactively offering customers rescheduling options to protect the CX score.

fleetflow_dispatch.division_context: Adjusts line-haul truck routes between Fulfillment Centers (FCs) and Sort Centers based on live India traffic data, weather alerts, and vehicle-specific road restrictions.

freight_control_tower.division_context: Tracks Delivery Service Partner (DSP) and 3PL tender acceptance and on-time performance to ensure the Amazon Transportation Services (ATS) routing guide is always utilizing the most reliable partners.

freight_bill_audit_agent.division_context: Audits carrier invoices against digital PODs and Coupa contracts to eliminate overbilling on fuel surcharges and detention fees for the India network.

short_dated_redistributor.division_context: Identifies near-expiry lots in Fulfillment Centers (FCs) like BLR8 and HYD13, automatically routing them to liquidation partners or food banks before they become unsellable.

terminology_highlights: FC (Fulfillment Center) — Massive warehouse facilities where seller and retail inventory is stowed, picked, packed, and shipped.
Supply Chain Optimization Technologies (SCOT) — Supply Chain Optimization Technologies, Amazon's proprietary AI engine for forecasting demand and automating inventory placement.
AMZL (Amazon Logistics) — The last-mile delivery network managing delivery stations, Delivery Service Partners (DSPs), and independent contractors.
IHS (I Have Space) — A hyper-local program partnering with neighborhood kirana stores for last-mile delivery and pickup.
